title: import — youngster

sentences.translation: 该项目的主要投资方是法国国民信贷银行。

sentences.sentence: multi-ethnic Britain
sentences.translation: 多种族的英国

sentences.sentence: But, to doing this loses the significance of emigration.
sentences.translation: 但是，这样做就失去了移民的意义。

sentences.sentence: They have known colonization, revolution and emigration.
sentences.translation: 他们了解殖民、革命还有移民。

phrases.translation: 移民身份；入境身份；在留资格

sentences.sentence: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
sentences.translation: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

sentences.sentence: a scheduling clash on TV
sentences.translation: 电视节目时间安排上的冲突

sentences.sentence: Hitherto, Budweiser has been at the forefront of the Americanisation of the world, often to the dismay of foreign drinkers of traditional beers who regard a Bud as a glass of water spoiled.
sentences.translation: 至今，百威啤酒一直是世界上最具美国特色的龙头产品，但常常令传统的外国品尝者失望，他们认为一杯百威只是一杯被变质的水。

sentences.sentence: There is also a belief that the decision, which was made by Reuters in the US, is further proof of the agency's Americanisation since it was acquired three years ago by Thomson.
sentences.translation: 人们同样有这样的看法：自从被托马斯收购三年来，美国的路透社所做的决议更深地证明了这一机构的美国化。

sentences.sentence: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
sentences.translation: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

sentences.sentence: Indeed, his descendants, the Mughal Emperors, continued to rule large swathes of the subcontinent until the last of the dynasty was deposed by the British in 1857.
sentences.translation: 果不其然，他的后代莫卧尔帝国继续统治大片亚洲次大陆，直到这个帝国的最后一个朝代于1857年被英国废黜。

sentences.sentence: Very roughly this river defines the north west edge of the Indian subcontinent and the Persians, Greeks, Romans and the rest of us applied the name to everything on the other side of that river.
sentences.translation: 这条河很粗略地定义了印第安次大陆的西北端，而波斯人、希腊人、罗马人和其他的人把这个名字应用到那条河对岸的任何事情。

sentences.sentence: The disease occurs in Africa, Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
sentences.translation: 此病发生在非洲、亚洲和印度次大陆。

sentences.sentence: And so, we get many more statements of "Japanese uniqueness" and the impossibility of foreigners truly understanding Japan.
sentences.translation: 因此，我们得到了许多“日本的独特性”的陈述，而外国人不可能真正了解日本。

sentences.sentence: No one everyone believed that the renal dialysis technology was a unique kind of technology, and it was because of that uniqueness that we believed it was affordable.
sentences.translation: 没有人认为，肾透析技术是一种独特的技术，而且由于这种独特性，我们就认为它是负担得起的。

sentences.sentence: The opposing armies were preparing for war.
sentences.translation: 敌对双方的军队都在备战。

sentences.sentence: The Socialist Party has split into two opposing camps.
sentences.translation: 社会党分裂成了两个对立的阵营。

sentences.sentence: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
sentences.translation: 她计划从政。

sentences.sentence: Students should pursue their own interests , as well as do their school work.
sentences.translation: 除了完成课业之外，学生也应该追求自己的兴趣。

sentences.sentence: a campaign promise to pursue policies that will help the poor
sentences.translation: 贯彻扶贫政策的竞选承诺

sentences.sentence: Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
sentences.translation: 南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。

sentences.sentence: The clams were delicious. Likewise, the eggplant was excellent.
sentences.translation: 蛤蜊味道鲜美，茄子也同样美味。

sentences.sentence: infectious diseases
sentences.translation: 传染性疾病

sentences.sentence: I tell teams working on print ads to start by creating a billboard.
sentences.translation: 我告诉平面广告的工作团队，从制作一个广告牌开始。

sentences.sentence: Stop being some company's billboard, and show us YOU.
sentences.translation: 停止做公司的广告牌，向我们展示 你自己 。

sentences.sentence: Other youngsters are not so lucky.
sentences.translation: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 121 单元

import
音标：英 /ɪm'pɔːt; 'ɪm-/  美 /'ɪmpɔt/
vt. 进口；输入；引进
短语：import and export — 进出口；导入和导出；输入和输出
短语：import and export corporation — [经]进出口公司
短语：import license — 进口许可证
短语：import from — 从…输入；从…进口
短语：import tariff — 进口关税
短语：import trade — 进口贸易
短语：parallel import — 平行进口
短语：import agent — 进口代理商
短语：import substitution — 进口替代
短语：import duty — 进口税
短语：import licence — 进口许可证；进口执照
短语：import tax — 进口税
短语：import declaration — 进口报单；进口声明书
短语：import permit — 进口护照；进口准许证
短语：import quota — 输入限额
短语：import data — 输入数据
短语：import price — [经]输入价格
短语：net import — 净进口
短语：import licensing — 进口许可
短语：import department — n. 进口部
例句：In 2001, Britain exported more cars than it imported.
2001年英国的汽车出口量大于进口。

ethnic
音标：英 /'eθnɪk/  美 /'ɛθnɪk/
adj. 异国风情的；人种的，种族的
短语：ethnic group — n. 同种同文化之民族
短语：ethnic minority — 少数民族
短语：ethnic chinese — 华裔人士
短语：ethnic culture — 民族文化；族群文化
短语：ethnic identity — 族群认同，种族认同；民族认同
短语：ethnic relations — 族群关系
短语：ethnic origin — 种族本源
短语：ethnic cleansing — n. 种族清洗
短语：ethnic composition — 种族构成
短语：ethnic tourism — 民俗旅游；异族观光
短语：ethnic food — 民族风味餐
短语：ethnic minority group — 少数人种群体
短语：ethnic affairs commission — 民族委员会；民族事务委员会
短语：ethnic drug — 民族药
例句：The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
该校教授不同种族的小学生。
例句：ethnic Russians in Estonia
居住在爱沙尼亚的俄罗斯人
例句：plans to partition the republic along ethnic lines
按种族分割该共和国的计划

non-native
adj. 非本国的，非本地的
例句：The release of non-native fish is controversial, because big predators like blue catfish almost certainly alter food webs and species diversity in areas where they are introduced.
放生非野生鲶鱼目前还是有争议的，因为像蓝鲶这样的大型捕食者几乎肯定会改变其引入地区的食物网和物种多样性。

multinational
音标：英 /mʌltɪ'næʃ(ə)n(ə)l/  美 /,mʌltɪ'næʃnəl/
adj. 跨国的，多国的
短语：multinational company — 多国公司
短语：multinational corporation — 跨国公司
短语：multinational enterprise — 跨国公司
例句：a multinational media corporation
跨国传媒公司

investor
音标：英 /ɪn'vestə/  美 /ɪn'vɛstɚ/
n. 投资者
短语：foreign investor — 外国投资者
短语：investor confidence — 投资信心；投资者信任
短语：institutional investor — 有组织的集体投资者；金融机构投资者
短语：investor relations — 投资者关系；投资者关系部；股东关系
短语：individual investor — 个人投资者；散户
短语：angel investor — n. 天使投资者（用自己的资金投资一家初创公司的富人）
例句：The main investor in the project is the French bank Credit National.
该项目的主要投资方是法国国民信贷银行。

multi-ethnic
adj. 多种族的
例句：multi-ethnic Britain
多种族的英国

emigration
音标：英 /,emɪ'greɪʃn/  美 /,ɛmə'greʃən/
n. 移民，移居
例句：But, to doing this loses the significance of emigration.
但是，这样做就失去了移民的意义。
例句：They have known colonization, revolution and emigration.
他们了解殖民、革命还有移民。

immigration
音标：英 /ɪmɪ'ɡreɪʃn/  美 /,ɪmɪ'ɡreʃən/
n. 外来的移民，移居入境
短语：illegal immigration — 非法移民；非法入境
短语：immigration office — 移民局
短语：immigration policy — 移民政策
短语：immigration officer — 移民局官员；入境关员
短语：immigration law — [法]移民法
短语：immigration status — 移民身份；入境身份；在留资格
短语：immigration act — 移民法；移民法案
短语：immigration official — n. 移民局官员
例句：He called for a common European policy on immigration.
他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

clash
音标：英 /klæʃ/  美 /klæʃ/
n. 冲突
短语：clash with — 与…冲突，不调和
例句：a scheduling clash on TV
电视节目时间安排上的冲突

Americanisation
n. 美国化
例句：Hitherto, Budweiser has been at the forefront of the Americanisation of the world, often to the dismay of foreign drinkers of traditional beers who regard a Bud as a glass of water spoiled.
至今，百威啤酒一直是世界上最具美国特色的龙头产品，但常常令传统的外国品尝者失望，他们认为一杯百威只是一杯被变质的水。
例句：There is also a belief that the decision, which was made by Reuters in the US, is further proof of the agency's Americanisation since it was acquired three years ago by Thomson.
人们同样有这样的看法：自从被托马斯收购三年来，美国的路透社所做的决议更深地证明了这一机构的美国化。

deprive
音标：英 /dɪ'praɪv/  美 /dɪ'praɪv/
vt. 剥夺，使丧失
短语：deprive of — vt. 剥夺；失去
例句：They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

come to the fore
变得重要，有影响力

subcontinent
音标：美 /,sʌb'kɑntɪnənt/
n. 次大陆
例句：Indeed, his descendants, the Mughal Emperors, continued to rule large swathes of the subcontinent until the last of the dynasty was deposed by the British in 1857.
果不其然，他的后代莫卧尔帝国继续统治大片亚洲次大陆，直到这个帝国的最后一个朝代于1857年被英国废黜。
例句：Very roughly this river defines the north west edge of the Indian subcontinent and the Persians, Greeks, Romans and the rest of us applied the name to everything on the other side of that river.
这条河很粗略地定义了印第安次大陆的西北端，而波斯人、希腊人、罗马人和其他的人把这个名字应用到那条河对岸的任何事情。
例句：The disease occurs in Africa, Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
此病发生在非洲、亚洲和印度次大陆。

uniqueness
音标：英 /ju:'ni:knis/  美 /jʊ'niknɪs/
n. 唯一性，独特性
短语：uniqueness theorem — 唯一性定理；单值定理
例句：And so, we get many more statements of "Japanese uniqueness" and the impossibility of foreigners truly understanding Japan.
因此，我们得到了许多“日本的独特性”的陈述，而外国人不可能真正了解日本。
例句：No one everyone believed that the renal dialysis technology was a unique kind of technology, and it was because of that uniqueness that we believed it was affordable.
没有人认为，肾透析技术是一种独特的技术，而且由于这种独特性，我们就认为它是负担得起的。

opposing
音标：英 /ə'pəʊzɪŋ/  美 /ə'pozɪŋ/
adj. 相反的，对立的
例句：The opposing armies were preparing for war.
敌对双方的军队都在备战。
例句：The Socialist Party has split into two opposing camps.
社会党分裂成了两个对立的阵营。

pursue
音标：英 /pə'sjuː/  美 /pə'sʊ/
vt. 追求，继续进行
短语：pursue after — v. 追赶
例句：She plans to pursue a career in politics.
她计划从政。
例句：Students should pursue their own interests , as well as do their school work.
除了完成课业之外，学生也应该追求自己的兴趣。
例句：a campaign promise to pursue policies that will help the poor
贯彻扶贫政策的竞选承诺

likewise
音标：英 /'laɪkwaɪz/  美 /'laɪkwaɪz/
adv. 同样地，也
例句：Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。
例句：The clams were delicious. Likewise, the eggplant was excellent.
蛤蜊味道鲜美，茄子也同样美味。

infectious
音标：英 /ɪn'fekʃəs/  美 /ɪn'fɛkʃəs/
adj. 有感染力的；传染病的
短语：infectious disease — 传染病
短语：infectious mononucleosis — 传染性单核细胞增多
短语：infectious disease hospital — 传染病院
例句：infectious diseases
传染性疾病

billboard
音标：英 /'bɪlbɔːd/  美 /'bɪlbɔrd/
n. 告示板，广告牌
例句：I tell teams working on print ads to start by creating a billboard.
我告诉平面广告的工作团队，从制作一个广告牌开始。
例句：Stop being some company's billboard, and show us YOU.
停止做公司的广告牌，向我们展示 你自己 。

youngster
音标：英 /'jʌŋstə/  美 /'jʌŋstɚ/
n. 年轻人，少年
例句：Other youngsters are not so lucky.
其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。
